body.question: May main preserve the pinned resolver bytes and run analytics recovery attempt2 via python -c plus runpy.run_path so sys.path[0] retains the repository working-directory import context, or must the resolver itself be revised and re-pinned?
body.blocking_constraint: The v4-authorized absolute-script invocation sets sys.path[0] to the helper's /private/tmp directory. PYTHONPATH=src then exposes product code but not the repository-root tests package, so unittest produced _FailedTest.tests before any of the five required analytics tests ran. Invocation repair is not yet authorized; product3 remains frozen and no recovery/full run may be inferred as PASS.

evidence.actual: native/child/helper exit 1, signal null, elapsed 0.429s, recovery_status FAIL, test_count/unittest_summary null

postflight_issues: native summary not clean five-test PASS

evidence.environment: Exact v4 allowlist retained PATH with repo .venv prefix, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, PYTHONPATH=src and the recorded necessary nonsecret variables
evidence.unchanged: Owned3+Refs3, all five frozen analytics inputs, canonical mismatch identity, listed full inputs and runtime remained unchanged; no product/data/gold/config/assertion/skip mutation occurred

options.name: unchanged resolver via runpy
options.procedure: Keep resolver path and SHA256 9cd31699... fixed. From repo cwd invoke the same .venv interpreter with python -c; set sys.argv exactly to [resolver_path, '--scope', 'analytics']; call runpy.run_path(resolver_path, run_name='__main__'). This preserves python -c sys.path[0] as the working-directory entry while executing the pinned helper logic unchanged.
options.evidence_rule: Use immutable prefix post-fusion-recovery-2 for start/result/native/stdout/stderr/input-manifest artifacts; capture the exact -c program bytes/hash or exact command, resolver hash, cwd/sys.path/import origins, five IDs/events, exit/signal, candidate/ref/input/runtime start/end identity.

options.name: revise and re-pin resolver
options.procedure: Add the verified repository root explicitly to sys.path inside the helper, then issue a complete updated directive with the new full helper bytes and SHA before execution.
options.tradeoff: This changes evidence tooling despite the failure being fully explained by invocation context and requires another pin/reconciliation cycle.

body.recommendation: A. It repairs only launcher import context, leaves the v4-pinned resolver and all product/test/data bytes unchanged, and matches the repository-root context used by -m unittest. Authorize only --scope analytics and the exact five expected IDs; the helper's available full scope remains prohibited.
body.impact: Preserve attempt1 as FAIL and never overwrite it. If accepted, main alone runs attempt2 under a complete updated DIRECTIVE. A valid attempt2 can set only recovery_status=PASS; native full remains FAIL/exit1, canonical_input_status remains UNREPAIRED_FROZEN_HASH_MISMATCH, and composed_regression_gate remains PENDING_REVIEW until fresh deep review. No focused/adjacent/isolated rerun, product edit, full fallback, experiment, model/API or integration is authorized.
